findings.title: IsDefined(typeof(HarmonyPatch), false) ignores inherited attributes
findings.detail: With inherit:false, a future patch class that inherits [HarmonyPatch] from a base class would be skipped with no log line. All 38 current patch targets are declared directly on their classes, so nothing is skipped today. Passing true there would remove the edge case without letting EntadAbilityPrep (no Harmony attribute at all) back in.

findings.title: Per-class catch can leave a multi-target class partly patched
findings.detail: For classes whose TargetMethods yields several originals (Patch_PowerGeneration, the CompRefuelable/CompHeatPusher transpilers), a failure on a later target is caught here after earlier targets may already be patched, so the 'that one feature is off' log is not quite true. Worth knowing when reading a failure report; catching inside TargetMethods (skipping originals that cannot be resolved) is one place to handle it.

findings.title: InjectStatParts is not isolated, so a throw there now blocks all patching
findings.detail: The order swap protects stat injection from patch failures, but an exception in InjectStatParts (e.g. from a malformed trait def's AllRanges) now exits the static constructor before PatchEachClass runs. Wrapping the InjectStatParts() call in its own try/Log.Error would make the isolation work both ways.
